editor.lede.new: Fill this in and it's ready to talk. Already have a Tavern card? Drop it in and the fields fill themselves.
editor.lede.edit: Remember to save. A card that's public has to be made private again before you can edit it.
editor.name: Character name
editor.userName.hint: How the character addresses the player. Leave it empty to use the player's own nickname.
editor.language.hint: The language decides which board this card appears on. It can't be changed later.
editor.detail.hint: The heart of the card: who they are, how they speak, what situation they're in. The more concrete, the more consistent the replies.
editor.contract.hint: What a reply should look like: how many paragraphs, whether to narrate, how to mark actions. Leave empty for the default.
editor.jailbreak.hint: Appended to every turn. Put the one or two rules that get forgotten most.
editor.welcome.hint: The first thing a player reads. Set the scene and the relationship here, or the story never starts.
editor.alternates.hint: A different way in, same story. Players get one at random when they start over.
editor.prologue.hint: First lines the player can just tap. Much better than staring at an empty box.
editor.talkExample.hint: A few exchanges showing how this character talks. Two or three is plenty; more locks them in.
editor.avatar.hint: Shown on the board and in chat. Square works best.
editor.background.hint: Behind the conversation. A very bright image makes the text hard to read.
editor.blockers: {n} more item(s) upstream; you'll see them when you submit.
editor.publish.hint: It goes through review first, and only appears to others once it passes.
editor.publish.saveFirst: You have unsaved changes. Save once before submitting.
editor.publish.confirm: This card goes into review, and becomes visible to everyone once it passes. Submit?
editor.needName: Give this card a name first.
wb.lede: A lorebook holds what doesn't belong in every turn but has to be right when it comes up: places, terms, side characters. It's pulled in when a keyword is mentioned.
wb.empty: This card has no lorebook yet.
wb.name: Lorebook name
wb.entry.name: Entry name
wb.entry.keywords.placeholder: Comma separated, e.g. Rain City, Old Docks
wb.entry.keywords.hint: Mention any one of these and this entry joins the conversation.
wb.entry.keywords.constantHint: Set to always-on, so it's included every turn regardless of keywords.
wb.entry.deleteConfirm: Deleting this entry can't be undone. Sure?
import.review.title: Read: {name}
import.review.overwrite: Applying this replaces what's currently in the form.
import.dropped.title: These didn't come across
import.drop.position: Insertion position on {n} entries. Where lore goes is decided here.
import.drop.caseSensitive: Case sensitivity on {n} entries. Matching here is always case-insensitive.
import.drop.bookSettings: Lorebook scan depth and budget. Handled here by the conversation's memory budget.
import.drop.mesExample: Example dialogue: the format didn't say who said what, so nothing was split out. You can add it under Dialogue.
import.drop.creator: Original author credit ({name}). The author here is whoever is signed in.
import.drop.groupGreetings: Group-chat-only greetings. There's no group chat here.
import.error.invalid: That file isn't a character card, or it's damaged.
import.error.noMetadata: No character data in that PNG — it's just an image.
import.error.charx: Can't read .charx yet. Export as PNG or JSON instead.
import.mmd.drop: Drop the three MMD export files here, all at once or one by one
import.mmd.formats: Regex export (JSON), worldbook (JSON), character definition (TXT). Any subset applies; fill the rest in the form.
import.mmd.error.invalidJson: {name}: broken JSON, could not read it.
import.mmd.error.unknown: {name}: doesn't look like a regex, worldbook, or definition file.
import.mmd.detailTooLong: The definition is {n} characters, over this site's limit of {max}. Trim it after applying before you can save.
export.title: Export
export.hint: Save it in the common format and take it elsewhere.
export.pngFallback: Couldn't fetch the avatar, so it was saved as JSON.
state.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Try another image or again later.
editor.draftRestored: Restored the draft you didn't save last time.
import.landed.image: 1 embedded portrait, used as the avatar
import.avatarFailed: The portrait couldn't be uploaded. Pick an image again under Images.
import.drop.tags: {n} extra tag(s). A card here holds at most 10, so only the first 10 were kept.
wb.import.error: No lorebook entries in this file. Use a lorebook JSON exported from SillyTavern, or a card that carries one.
wb.import.done: Imported {n} entries, appended after the existing ones.
wb.entry.secondary.placeholder: Leave empty to trigger on keywords alone
wb.entry.secondary.hint: When set, both must appear: any keyword plus any of these.
import.split.entries: {n} entries were longer than {max} characters and were split into parts sharing the same keywords; nothing was cut.
wb.entry.content.over: Over {max} characters won't be accepted; split it into two entries with the same keywords for the same effect.
regex.title: Regex rules
regex.bar.hint: AI replies are rewritten by these rules on the player's screen before they show.
regex.pick: Pick a rule on the left, or add one.
regex.rule.name: Name
regex.rule.find.placeholder: /『([\s\S]*?)』/g or a literal marker such as <status>
regex.rule.find.literal: Literal text: every occurrence is replaced.
regex.rule.replace.hint: HTML, CSS and JS are allowed.
regex.statusbar.hint: A fixed block on the top layer of the chat page. Viewers see it, the AI never does. Put markers for global styling and side tools here; rules expand them too.
regex.lowered.hint: When checked it sits under the composer.
regex.test.placeholder: Paste an AI reply to preview the result
regex.discard: Changes haven't been applied to the form. Close anyway?
regex.imported: Read {n} rules. They save with the card.
regex.importFailed: No regex rules in this file. Use a Meimo export, a character card, or a regex_scripts array.
regex.issue.badRegex: Invalid regex; this rule won't run
regex.issue.totalLong: The rule set is too large
play.title: Play
play.loadFailed: The stage failed to load. Please try again later.
